title: TITLE:
prompt:
TITLE:
White Denim Apron Beach Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style summer beach lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic natural skin texture with subtle pores and small imperfections.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long dark brown hair, naturally damp from the sea, with soft see-through bangs and realistic wet strands.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural summer makeup.
Healthy fair skin.
Subtle water droplets on skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Full natural bust.
Slim waist.
Soft natural curves.
Realistic anatomy and body proportions.

OUTFIT:
Minimalist white denim apron with an overall-inspired construction.
Low-set apron bib front with a wide open neckline.
Two white denim shoulder straps extending upward from the bib.
Visible metal adjusters and fasteners on the straps.
Open sides with apron ties secured around the waist.
Clearly defined separate front apron panel ending at the upper thighs.
Authentic white denim weave, visible stitching, and realistic fabric folds.
Natural tension, movement, and draping of the apron fabric.
Simple contemporary summer design.
Bare shoulders and arms.
Black sunglasses resting naturally on top of her head.
No jewelry.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Bright sunny tropical summer beach.
Clean pale sand beside a crystal-clear turquoise-blue ocean.
Gentle waves along the shoreline.
Fine realistic beach sand and detailed natural ocean textures.
Vivid blue summer sky with soft white clouds.
Tropical greenery and palm trees visible in the distance.
Relaxed summer vacation atmosphere.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Kneeling naturally on the beach sand close to the shoreline.
Legs relaxed and slightly apart in a natural kneeling pose.
Torso facing mostly toward the camera.
One hand resting naturally near her thigh.
The other hand lightly touching the sunglasses resting on top of her head.
Looking directly into the camera.
Calm, slightly playful expression.

CAMERA:
Vertical 3:4 composition.
Eye-level to slightly elevated camera angle.
Close three-quarter body framing.
Approximately 28–35mm equivalent lens perspective.
Subject centered prominently in the frame.
Ocean and shoreline extending diagonally behind the subject.
Natural perspective without artificial lens distortion.
Natural depth of field.

LIGHTING:
Strong natural midsummer sunlight.
Direct sunlight from above and slightly camera-left.
Realistic defined shadows.
Bright natural highlights on wet hair and damp skin.
Sunlight reflecting naturally from the ocean and pale beach sand.
Natural high-contrast outdoor exposure.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
No distorted hands or fingers.
No unnatural body proportions.
